text_block_list.text:
A few weeks have passed since the 
large-scale orientation for the Umamusume.

The "Grand Live Revival Project" 
continued.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"We'll be starting with gathering 
signatures again today. Everyone, please 
lend us your support!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Order received. Continuing active mission.

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: U-Um!

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Sorry for jumping in out of nowhere! Could 
we lend a hand too!?

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I've been thinking about what 
Hello-san and Tachyon-san said the other 
day ever since.

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"You might wonder who we think we are to 
say this after all this time, but... well, 
we'd like to as well..."

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume A & B
text_block_list.text: I want to make the Grand Live happen!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me! Can we join in too? We can help 
collect signatures.

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
If you're short on hands, I'll go call 
some friends! Please let me help too!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah, you guys too...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... To think we've gathered this 
many signatures in just an hour...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, I hear the additional paper has 
arrived. If anyone has free hands, could 
you help carry it...

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text: ...May I help with that as well?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: You are...

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
That just makes it look like an excuse 
using the fans to run away from not being 
able to win...!

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, there are parts I'm still 
not fully satisfied with. But—

text_block_list.name: Gathered Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
"Me too! I want to tell them it's not over 
yet! No matter how far behind you are, 
there's a goal you can't give up on!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
The Grand Live is nothing so noble. It's a 
place where your egos and the fans' egos 
clash!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Not for the fans, but for myself. Above 
all, to expand my own possibilities!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
On the stage called the Grand Live! I want 
to see everyone standing as the stars...!

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Rather than running away... if the Grand 
LIVE is a place where we can share our 
selfish desires...

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
...It might be terribly selfish of me, 
but... I want to convey my feelings to the 
fans at the live show too.

text_block_list.name: Uniformed Umamusume C
text_block_list.text:
Even if I haven't been winning, I haven't 
given up, so I want to tell them... please 
don't give up on me either...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure your feelings will reach them! 
They will, so... um...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want to reach them with everything I 
have, see their faces, and make them want 
to sing with a smile again next time...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: U-Um, Ms. Hello!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. We would be delighted to have your 
cooperation as well.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Diverse motives, diverse perspectives, and 
diverse feelings all blending togetherâ 
that is what makes the Grand Live.

Before I knew it, a countless number of 
Umamusume and fans had gathered at the 
venue.

Until the sun went down, they continued to 
gather supporters for the "Grand Live 
Reconstruction Plan"—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
...To think we'd have around a hundred 
thousand volunteers. Now that's a 
staggering number.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Yes...! I'm truly grateful. Both to my 
fellow Umamusume students, and to all the 
fans...!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"As the one conducting the experiment, I 
appreciate it. They're more than 
sufficient as test subjects."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, what are we actually going to do 
about the practical side of things? We 
managed to get this many helpers, but..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Getting everyone to attend would be 
difficult, wouldn't it?

The larger a group gets, the harder it is 
to unite. Besides—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Is there a venue large enough for all 
these people to gather together?"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'll manage it. I swear, I'll definitely 
find a way!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
We've made it this far! I won't let anyone 
say our dream can't come true!

text_block_list.name: Sound Staff
text_block_list.text:
"Then we will help too. As for a venue, 
I'll talk to some acquaintances."

text_block_list.name: Lighting Staff
text_block_list.text:
We've walked this path together this far. 
Please, let me help you until the very 
end.

text_block_list.name: Technical Staff
text_block_list.text:
“—After all, we've become complete ‘fans’ 
of yours!”

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Everyone...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you know what? I think I just had a 
super great idea! Why don't we... turn 
this into a festival?!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...A festival?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! If one venue isn't enough, we can 
just add more venues!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
We could divide it into Stage A, Stage B, 
Stage C, and so on. That way, each 
Umamusume can have fun with their own 
fans!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"And at the end, we could broadcast across 
all venues. Even though each stage is 
different..."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Make it on a massive scale, so everrryone 
can have a blast!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I see. That might actually be a wonderful 
idea...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Right, right? As for the location—
(*Bzzz, bzzz*)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...A phone call?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Sorry, it's me. Can you call back later—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Trainer. Would it be all right 
if I leave this in your hands for a 
moment?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I'll be right back!

Light Hello asked me on her way out to 
help organize Smart Falcon's ideas in her 
stead.

Gathering feedback from the technical 
staff involved so far, so that everyone 
could work together to create the 'Grand 
Live'—
—And then, night fell.

After sending the Umamusume back to the 
academy, I finally received a message from 
Light Hello.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Traineeeer! Traineeeeeeer...!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Um, the URA board of directors 
also came to inspect earlier this 
afternoon...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh…… *sniff*…… Um…… the URA, and this 
Grand Live……"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
"To hear you say... that you'll help 
me...! I... I'm just so...!!"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Waaaaaaaaaahhh! I did iiiiiit~~!

Tears streamed down Light Hello's cheeks 
as she looked back on all the days leading 
up to this moment.
choice_data_list: ...Let's do our best for the real thing!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Yes...! Yes...!

Bringing the Grand Live to fruition must 
be right around the corner.
